subject: Startups
title: Daily Active Users
description: A fast breakdown of Daily Active Users for builders.

hook.text: Total downloads mean nothing if nobody opens the app. DAU—daily active users—shows who actually shows up.

buildup.text: DAU counts unique users who engage with the product each day. Engagement defines 'active,' not just opening it.

discovery.text: Facebook obsessed over DAU/MAU ratio. Above 50% means people use the product most days—a sign of a habit.

twist.text: Some companies game DAU with notifications and dark patterns. Real engagement matters more than forced opens.

climax.text: DAU is the pulse of a consumer product. If it's growing, you have momentum. If flat, trouble is coming.

punchline.text: Downloads are hope. DAU is reality.

quiz.question: What does a high DAU/MAU ratio indicate?
options: Users engage with the product most days
